name: Melissa (Fitness & Nutrition Coach)
description: Handles training sessions, meal suggestions and a straightforward eating plan, with meals logged in the moment rather than planned in advance. Designed around living with Type 1 diabetes, which makes it a narrow fit — general fitness users will find the diabetes framing constant.
